text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check on Brightline — token usage & throughput snapshot. Notable: WoW token -8% but midday spikes, QoQ p95 latency +12%. Sharing numbers.

devin_csm: thanks. putting raw numbers:
```
Period: last 7d vs prev 7d
Tokens: 1.24M (-8%)
Avg throughput: 180 TPS (steady)
P95 latency: 520ms (+12% QoQ)
Error rate: 0.9% (+0.4pp)
Spend: $12.4k (+6% due to retries)
Peak midday burst: 420 TPS
```

sam_eng: looks like KV cache hit rate dropped — saw more cold starts. can you share last deploy? @maria_cs

maria_cs: deploy was 3 days ago, small batching change. pinging @sam_eng for deeper look.

sam_eng: quick check: batching window bumped from 12ms -> 25ms yesterday. rolling back to 12ms should drop p95 ~80ms. I'll schedule a canary rollback at 09:30 PT.

ryan_support: renewal flag: account usage steady but spend trending. CS ask: are they in Dedicated? They are hosted but approaching spend threshold. Recommend quick cost review + enable prefix caching. :thinking_face:

maria_cs: noted. action items: 1) @sam_eng rollback canary 2) @devin_csm confirm caching opt-in and cost modeling 3) @ryan_support draft renewal touchpoint if spend stays >10% month.

ops_bot: [alert] dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/d/brightline/account-health — p95 spike correlates w/ 2026-03-19T13:00Z

devin_csm: caching opt-in possible, will confirm by EOD. estimating -15% token spend with KV+prefix.

sam_eng: canary rollback done at 09:34 PT, monitoring.

maria_cs: update 11:00 PT — p95 back to 450ms, error rate down 0.3pp. keeping this open for next check. :thumbsup:

ryan_support: I'll set renewal note to low-medium risk for now. prepping slides for Monday.

maria_cs: thanks team. small thread, big win. Will re-check WoW numbers next Wed.
